description: Road Closures is a dataset listed in City of Baton Rouge open data portal (data.brla.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Baton Rouge. Line geometry with attributes displaying active City-Parish road closures, road blocks, and detours in East Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana. Coverage: Baton Rouge. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Infrastructure. Its tags are detour, transportation, traffic, road, gis. The table has 21 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation and Drainage Services - Traffic Engineering Divisio. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-brla-gov-portal.
